# VIP Gece

VIP Gece is an Istanbul-focused profile directory with public listing, category,
district, contact, and profile detail pages. Each profile owns its own contact
channel on the detail page; there is no single site-wide WhatsApp number.

## Primary Public URLs

- [VIP Gece ana sayfa](https://vip-gece.site/)
- [İstanbul bölge merkezi](https://vip-gece.site/istanbul-escort)
- [Kategoriler](https://vip-gece.site/kategoriler)
- [Tüm ilanlar](https://vip-gece.site/ilanlar)
- [İletişim rehberi](https://vip-gece.site/iletisim)
- [Hakkımızda ve politikalar](https://vip-gece.site/guven-ve-politikalar)

## Canonical Hubs

- Soft paths such as `/istanbul` redirect with 301 to `/istanbul-escort`
- Profile pages live under `/profil/{slug}`
- District and category landings use `/{slug}-escort` or defined category slugs

## Sitemaps

- [Web site haritası](https://vip-gece.site/sitemap.xml)
- [Görsel site haritası](https://vip-gece.site/image-sitemap.xml)

## Crawling Notes

Public indexable pages are listed in the sitemap. Admin, backup, temporary, and
non-public paths are disallowed in robots.txt. Contact is a guide page: use
profile detail pages for per-listing messaging.
